title: DABE Paper Artifact: Fixed Chunks with Sparse Lexical Repair
description: Software and lightweight reproducibility artifacts for the paper Density-Adaptive Bitmask Encoding: Fixed Chunks with Sparse Lexical Repair. The artifact includes source code, selected configs, figure generation data, experiment logs, launch contracts, and Modal JSON/CSV summaries supporting the paper's fixed-chunk sparse-repair tokenizer-autoencoder results.
